Cache hit with OpenDAL memory backend returns cached response on repeat request

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import ChatCompletionRequest

async def main() -> None:
    client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
    request = ChatCompletionRequest.from_json("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o\"}")
    result = await client.chat(request)
    print(result)

asyncio.run(main())
```
